n1f5c9ecf42.headline: Europe expands night train network as rail becomes more popular
n1f5c9ecf42.summary: Both state railroads and private operators in Europe are expanding night train services to encourage travelers to switch from airplanes to sleeper cars.
n1f5c9ecf42.why: Growth in rail travel and night trains reflects changing transportation preferences and environmental policies, impacting travel and infrastructure sectors.

n6e6c87dd8d.headline: Jewelry business VS pandemic: Sales fell by 70% — Is there a prospect? (list of jewelry company owners) — Tazabek
n6e6c87dd8d.summary: The jewelry sector experienced a 70% drop in sales during the pandemic, according to the head of the Jewelers Association, highlighting severe industry challenges.
n6e6c87dd8d.why: The pandemic's impact on luxury goods sales affects related companies, supply chains, and consumer spending patterns.
